svg.aria-label: Measured medians, lower is better, before at baseline ba5b14e and after. Member-panel layout with 1,000 members: 2.118 ms to 0.262 ms, 8.08 times faster. Mention search with 1,000 members and no match: 0.691 ms to 0.205 ms, 3.37 times. Timeline layout with 1,000 member-join messages: 5.141 ms to 0.449 ms, 11.45 times. The slowest gain is 237% more throughput.
